problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; original Chinese explanation and proof.
facts: The input contains the three bracket pairs (), [], and {}.
Opening brackets must close with the same type.
Closing order must respect nesting; all brackets must be closed.

claims.claim: The stack contains exactly the unmatched opening brackets in opening order.
Every character is pushed or popped at most once, giving O(n) time and O(n) worst-case auxiliary space.
claims.validation: Linear scan and stack size bound.
